context:
Goal: the live file (the session and pull request snapshot at roadmap/live/live.json) holds only rows that earn their size.
Problem (goal): archived session rows are 1,903 of its 2,304 session rows and about a third of the file, and whether they are worth keeping is a rule choice about what the lost-work report may see, which only you can make.
Based on (measured): triage's size count of the live file (its rows were read at 14:38 CST): 1,291,768 bytes in all; the session rows are 531,754 bytes, of which archived rows 431,909; statuses archived 1,903, idle 395, running 4, requires-action 2; each row holds only an id, a status, tags and a status bucket.
Based on (read): the page build and the idle-lane report (merge --idle-lanes) both skip archived rows (skills/roadmap/build.py lines 894 and 2004-2010); the lost-work report (merge --ledger) reads the archived status of a lane to print 'its lane is archived, pull request open' and 'its lane is gone' (merge/merge.py lines 5612-5651). Read from the plugin copy on this machine, not checked against main.
Departs from: main — adds a rule that drops archived session rows from the live file.
Waiting on: nothing is stopped; runner 12 asked and acts on nothing; step live-file-refresh-one-command takes your pick.
Meanwhile: a refresh still reads all 24 pages of sessions either way, so the saving is file size, not reads.

options.gain: The lost-work report keeps seeing an archived lane that still has an open pull request.
options.how: No change: the file keeps all 2,304 rows, 1,903 of them archived.
options.label: Keep all session rows in the live file
options.lose: The file stays 1.29 MB, a third of it archived rows that two readers skip.

options.gain: The file shrinks by about 0.43 MB (33%).
options.how: The refresh drops every archived row, leaving 401 rows.
options.label: Keep only idle, running and requires-action rows
options.lose: The lost-work report can no longer tell an archived lane with an open pull request from a lane the file does not list; it reports it as unknown or gone instead.

options.gain: The file shrinks and the lost-work report keeps its archived-lane signal.
options.how: A builder changes the refresh to keep an archived row only when an open pull request's footer or a live step's lane names that session.
options.label: Keep non-archived rows, plus archived rows a live pull request or step names (recommended)
options.lose: A builder lane and one more rule in the refresh; the saving is smaller than b (unmeasured).

reply: Closed on your pick c (saved on the page, 18:32 CST): the live file keeps non-archived session rows, plus an archived row that an open pull request's footer or a live step's lane names. It is filed as the refresh rule on step live-file-refresh-one-command, which triage builds with its own test-author, builder and reviewer.

title: The live file keeps 1,903 archived session rows: keep them, drop them, or keep only the ones something still names?
why: c keeps the one thing archived rows are used for and drops the rest; a keeps a third of the file for two readers that skip it; b loses the lost-work signal. Recommended by triage, not owner-typed.
